title: Greenwave Technology Solutions, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-22
summary: Greenwave Technology Solutions, Inc. (GWAV), a small-cap Nasdaq Capital Market-listed company, received a delisting warning from Nasdaq on April 20, 2026 for failing to timely file its 2025 Form 10-K annual report, citing non-compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1). The company has 60 days to submit a compliance plan and may receive an extension until October 12, 2026 if accepted. Trading continues unaffected for now.
key_points: Nasdaq Staff issued a Notice of Delisting concern on April 20, 2026 due to overdue 2025 Form 10-K filing
Company listed on Nasdaq Capital Market under ticker GWAV; trading not immediately affected
Company has 60 calendar days to submit a compliance plan to regain listing standards
If compliance plan is accepted, extension may be granted until October 12, 2026
Greenwave is a Delaware corporation headquartered in Chesapeake, VA; CEO is Danny Meeks
